(def get-in
  "Returns the value in a nested associative structure,
  where ks is a sequence of keys. Returns nil if the key is not present,
  or the not-found value if supplied."
  (let [lookup get same? identical?]
    (fn
      ([m ks]
       (let [step (suss.bootstrap/public-core-value get)]
         (loop [m m ks (seq ks)]
           (if ks (recur (step m (first ks)) (next ks)) m))))
      ([m ks not-found]
       (loop [sentinel (Unique.) m m ks (seq ks)]
         (if ks
           (let [value (lookup m (first ks) sentinel)]
             (if (same? sentinel value) not-found
                 (recur sentinel value (next ks))))
           m))))))
